papers.title: LiveAudio: From Bidirectional to Autoregressive Diffusion for Real-Time Streaming Video-to-Audio Generation
papers.abstract: Video-to-audio generation synthesizes sound that matches a video in content and timing, with applications ranging from film post-production to live streaming, games and interactive world models. Interactive applications receive video continuously and need the sound to follow it in real time, yet most existing video-to-audio models are bidirectional and must observe an entire clip before producing any sound. We propose LiveAudio, a streaming video-to-audio framework that generates high-quality and synchronized audio in real time while the video is playing. In contrast to prior streaming models trained from scratch, LiveAudio converts a bidirectional model into a streaming generator so as to build on its audio quality and synchronization. LiveAudio generates audio block by block, and each block depends only on the video that has already been played. The streaming generator is obtained from the bidirectional model through progressive causal fine-tuning and distillation, so that each block needs only a few sampling steps. Experiments on VGGSound show that LiveAudio outperforms existing streaming models in audio quality and synchronization, and surpasses the bidirectional model it starts from in synchronization. On a single A100 GPU, it runs in real time with a real-time factor of 0.79 and a time to first frame of 143 ms. Audio samples are available at https://streamaudio.github.io.
papers.summary_cn: 本文研究实时流式视频到音频生成，目标是在视频持续到达时立即生成与画面内容和时间同步的声音。作者提出 LiveAudio，将一个离线双向视频到音频扩散模型逐步转换为自回归扩散生成器。模型采用因果音频 VAE、块因果 DiT、无前瞻的同步对齐视频条件以及已完成音频块的 KV 缓存，实现逐块生成和即时播放。训练分为四阶段：双向模型预训练、块因果微调、因果 ODE 蒸馏和非对称分布匹配蒸馏。最后一个阶段利用双向教师模型改善因果生成造成的同步损失，同时保持因果性和少步采样。在 VGGSound 上，LiveAudio 在流式模型中取得更好的音频质量和同步性，去同步指标也优于所使用的离线教师模型；其四步、无 CFG 推理在单张 A100 上达到实时运行，首帧延迟为 143 毫秒、实时因子为 0.79。模型还支持流式视频文本到音频和文本到音频生成，并展示了超过训练长度的长时生成能力。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 提出 LiveAudio，将双向视频到音频模型转换为实时自回归扩散生成器，而不是从头训练流式模型。 2. 提出渐进式离线到在线训练流程，依次通过同步对齐视频条件和块因果微调实现因果生成，再通过 ODE 蒸馏将采样压缩为四步、去除分类器自由引导，最后通过非对称 DMD 恢复并提升音视频同步性。 3. 设计因果音频 VAE、块因果 DiT、同步对齐视频条件和块级 KV 缓存，使音频能够按块生成、解码并即时播放，同时避免重复计算历史上下文。 4. 在 VGGSound 上验证了方法在音频质量、模态对齐和实时效率方面相较现有流式模型的优势，并验证了流式视频文本到音频和文本到音频能力。
papers.relevance_cn: 该工作与研究重点直接相关，核心是将视频到音频扩散模型改造成自回归、因果、流式的实时生成系统。它使用块因果注意力、过去视频条件、KV 缓存和四步 ODE 蒸馏，具体解决了长序列生成中的前视限制、采样开销和持续推理问题。其面向直播、游戏和交互式世界模型，能够在视频播放过程中闭环地产生同步声音；不过它生成的是音频而非视觉视频，因此与视频生成和视觉世界模型的关系主要体现在流式多模态生成、实时推理和交互式模拟方法上。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确显示，因果化会降低音频质量和音视频同步性，需要额外的非对称 DMD 才能恢复同步；DMD 还会带来一定的模式寻求效应，使部分分布匹配指标变差。模型规模约为 12 亿参数，实时性是在单张 NVIDIA A100、批大小为 1 的条件下测得，其他硬件或部署环境下的性能未明确说明。实验主要在 VGGSound 测试集以及 AudioCaps 测试集上进行，跨数据集、复杂噪声、真实直播流和更长时长场景的泛化能力未充分说明。论文提到长时生成实验位于附录，但正文未给出详细结果。相较离线模型，流式模型无法使用未来视频和音频上下文，因此理论上存在前视信息缺失；其对复杂长期依赖的影响未明确说明。除论文报告的指标和主观评测外，用户体验、音频多样性及资源消耗的更全面限制未明确说明。
papers.abstract_cn: 视频到音频生成旨在合成在内容和时间上与视频相匹配的声音，应用范围从电影后期制作到直播、游戏和交互式世界模型。交互式应用会持续接收视频，并要求声音实时跟随视频，但现有大多数视频到音频模型都是双向的，必须观察完整视频片段后才能产生声音。我们提出 LiveAudio，一种流式视频到音频框架，可在视频播放过程中实时生成高质量且同步的音频。不同于从头训练的既有流式模型，LiveAudio 将双向模型转换为流式生成器，从而继承其音频质量和同步能力。LiveAudio 按音频块逐块生成，每个音频块只依赖已经播放的视频。该流式生成器通过渐进式因果微调和蒸馏从双向模型获得，因此每个音频块只需少量采样步骤。在 VGGSound 上的实验表明，LiveAudio 在音频质量和同步性方面优于现有流式模型，并且在同步性方面超过了作为其起点的双向模型。在单张 A100 GPU 上，它能够实时运行，实时因子为 0.79，首帧延迟为 143 毫秒。音频样例见 https://streamaudio.github.io。

papers.title: Mass Forcing: On-Policy Mass-Aware Distillation for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for real-time video synthesis, distilling pretrained diffusion models into few-step autoregressive generators. However, its reverse-KL objective is mode-seeking and can collapse the student's conditional video distribution onto a narrow subset of modes, leading to reduced sample diversity, diminished temporal dynamics, and color oversaturation. Existing methods mitigate this issue mainly via coverage-oriented student initialization, but we observe that such coverage is transient: across three initializations, the fraction of dynamic videos drops sharply during subsequent DMD training, indicating that the mode-seeking objective, not the initialization, drives this degradation. We propose Mass Forcing, a probability-mass-aware framework that moves on-policy DMD supervision from whole videos to individual states. Each update branches several continuations from a shared student-generated prefix, making the student's probability mass at that state measurable against the teacher. First, Mass Forcing estimates relative teacher-to-student density ratios among these continuations through latent-space score integration and uses them to rebalance conditional DMD updates, amplifying rollouts underrepresented relative to the teacher. Second, since mismatched mode probabilities do not necessarily induce strong local score corrections, it aligns generated rollout sets with a reweighted reference distribution defined by the same mass estimates, providing cross-rollout supervision. Experiments on MovieGen and VBench show that Mass Forcing improves video fidelity and sustains temporal dynamics throughout training, achieving the highest Total scores among compared methods and a Dynamic Degree of 83% after 1,000 generator updates, versus 12-32% for the baselines, with no additional inference-time overhead.
papers.summary_cn: 论文指出，少步自回归视频模型采用基于学生样本的反向KL蒸馏时，会在持续训练中逐渐偏向少数、近乎静态的模式；改进初始化只能延缓这一问题。Mass Forcing在学生生成的同一前缀后采样多个延续，通过教师与学生分数差异的潜空间积分估计相对概率质量，并以此进行局部条件分数重加权和基于MMD的轨迹集合匹配。该方法在MovieGen和VBench上提升了整体质量与动态性，在四步自回归推理和推理成本不变的情况下，训练1,000次后动态视频比例达到83%。
papers.contribution_cn: 1. 通过比较三种初始化方式的持续训练轨迹，揭示了DMD寻模目标而非初始化本身导致了动态性和模式覆盖的后期坍缩。 2. 提出Mass Forcing，将基于策略的DMD监督从完整视频改为共享学生前缀下的多延续、逐状态监督，使条件概率质量可被估计。 3. 利用现有教师分数网络和伪分数网络之间的分数差异进行潜空间路径积分，估计教师相对学生的延续概率质量，无需额外教师生成样本或辅助GAN判别器。 4. 设计两个互补目标：仅重加权条件分数修正而保持CFG均匀的局部质量加权蒸馏，以及用质量估计构造参考分布并通过MMD进行的轨迹集合匹配。 5. 在MovieGen和VBench上验证了方法在视频质量和时间动态方面相对多种自回归蒸馏基线的改进，且不增加推理时延或推理计算。
papers.relevance_cn: 与研究重点高度相关。该工作直接面向实时视频生成和视频扩散蒸馏，目标是将双向扩散教师压缩为少步、自回归、可流式生成的学生模型。它通过共享前缀后的多轨迹分支、逐状态条件分布匹配和概率质量重加权，缓解自回归视频生成中的模式坍缩与动态性丢失问题；其标准四步推理保持不变，报告17 FPS和0.69秒后续块延迟，适用于低延迟生成。方法还复用了前缀KV缓存和同一批轨迹进行训练监督，与缓存复用、稀疏或高效训练相关，但论文并未提出稀疏注意力。它主要关注训练期的覆盖保持，而不是动作条件世界模型或闭环交互仿真。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文明确指出：所有延续都由当前学生生成，因此若学生已经完全停止生成某个教师支持的模式，Mass Forcing无法重新发现或提升该模式；该方法应从ODE初始化阶段开始使用。质量权重依赖学习得到的伪分数网络以及有限数量的K个延续，因此只是面向覆盖的近似量，并非精确的密度比或精确的前向KL优化。实验默认每个前缀使用K=4个延续，减少延续数量会降低部分质量指标；更强的重加权系数也会降低动态性和质量。论文还报告了部分指标上的权衡，例如VBench成像质量低于Self Forcing，MovieGen语义分数低于Causal Forcing。论文未明确说明在更大规模数据集、更多视频领域或超长视频上的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_cn: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）已成为实时视频合成的一种有前景范式，它将预训练扩散模型蒸馏为少步自回归生成器。然而，其反向 KL 目标具有寻模性质，可能使学生模型的条件视频分布坍缩到少数模式，导致样本多样性降低、时间动态减弱以及颜色过度饱和。现有方法主要通过面向覆盖的学生初始化来缓解这一问题，但我们观察到，这种初始覆盖是短暂的：在三种初始化方式下，动态视频的比例都会在后续 DMD 训练中急剧下降，表明造成退化的是寻模目标，而非初始化方式。为此，我们提出 Mass Forcing，一种概率质量感知框架，将基于策略的 DMD 监督从完整视频转移到单个状态。每次更新都从共享的学生生成前缀分支出多个延续，使得能够将学生在该状态的概率质量与教师进行比较。首先，Mass Forcing 通过在潜空间中积分分数差异，估计这些延续之间相对的教师与学生密度比，并利用该比率重新平衡条件 DMD 更新，从而放大相对于教师而言代表不足的轨迹。其次，由于模式概率不匹配未必会产生明显的局部分数修正，我们使用相同的质量估计定义重新加权的参考分布，并使生成的轨迹集合与之对齐，从而提供跨轨迹监督。MovieGen 和 VBench 上的实验表明，Mass Forcing 提高了视频保真度，并在整个训练过程中维持时间动态；其在对比方法中取得最高的 Total 分数，并在 1,000 次生成器更新后达到 83% 的 Dynamic Degree，而基线为 12%–32%，且不会增加推理时开销。

papers.title: SOAR: Training-Free Rank-Consistent Rollout Compression for Latent World Model Planning
papers.abstract: Latent world models plan by rolling out hundreds of candidate action sequences through a transformer predictor, so a single decision can take tens of seconds. Existing accelerations prune spatial tokens as in vision-language models, yet a sampling-based planner uses predicted costs only to rank candidates, so a rollout can be compressed freely as long as the ranking survives. We propose SOAR, a training-free method that adapts rollout compression to each planning decision. At every decision, SOAR probes a few candidates under several token budgets and keeps the smallest budget that preserves their ranking, so it compresses as far as the current decision allows, without task labels. A closed-loop study of more than 80,000 episodes fixes the rest of the rollout: the first step, which alone reads a real observation, stays exact, and the context frame is cached rather than recomputed. On seven navigation and manipulation tasks with frozen checkpoints, SOAR matches dense-level planning success at 2.3x speedup and retains 98% at 2.5x. Our code is available at https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR.
papers.comment: 16 pages, including supplementary material. Anqi Li and Kai Liu contributed equally
papers.summary_cn: 论文研究冻结潜在世界模型中的规划加速问题。基于交叉熵方法的规划器需要对大量候选动作序列进行自回归滚动预测，但规划器实际只关心候选代价的排序，而不要求特征或代价数值本身完全重建。作者沿空间位置、上下文帧、滚动时间步和预测器深度四个维度进行超过 80,000 个闭环回合的系统分析，发现空间标记选择存在较低上限，第一步对后续排序最关键，上下文帧在部分操作任务中不可丢弃但可以通过键值缓存复用。基于这些发现，SOAR 保持第一步完整计算，缓存上下文帧，并在后续步骤使用嵌套的棋盘格标记预算。它利用首轮少量候选在不同预算下的 Spearman 排名相关性，在线选择每次决策的最小可接受预算。在七项导航和操作任务中，SOAR 以约 2.31 倍速度达到与密集模型相当的成功率，并能根据任务及具体决策自适应调整压缩程度。
papers.contribution_cn:
1. 提出以候选精英集合的排序一致性作为采样式规划滚动压缩标准，而非以特征或代价数值重建误差作为标准，并给出排序保持时 CEM 决策不变的命题。
2. 通过四个压缩维度和大规模闭环实验系统诊断冗余来源：空间选择收益有限；读取真实观测的第一步必须保持精确；上下文帧应保留但不应重复计算；不同任务对空间细节和时间上下文的需求不同。
3. 提出无需训练、无需任务标签的 SOAR 在线预算选择方法：使用少量首轮候选，在多个标记预算下进行探测，并依据与完整预算结果的 Spearman 排名相关性选择预算。
4. 结合精确第一步、上下文键值缓存和后续帧的嵌套棋盘格采样，在七项导航与操作任务上实现密集级规划成功率约 2.3 倍加速，并在更激进压缩下保持较高成功率。
papers.relevance_cn: 论文与研究重点高度相关。它直接研究潜在世界模型中的动作条件规划和闭环仿真，并通过自回归滚动预测候选动作序列来支持决策。其核心方法涉及因果时间结构、长序列滚动中的计算压缩、实时规划、键值缓存复用和稀疏标记处理。SOAR 不改变冻结世界模型或训练新的稀疏模型，而是根据候选排序在线决定每次规划应使用的计算预算，因此对实时动作条件视觉世界模型尤其有价值。第一步保持完整、后续步骤压缩以及上下文帧缓存的设计，也说明了误差在因果滚动中的累积方式和缓存历史状态对闭环控制的重要性。
papers.limitations_cn: 论文的实验主要基于采用双帧预测器的已发布 JEPA-WM 冻结检查点，结论能否推广到更长上下文的预测器尚未验证。排序一致性命题适用于仅依据候选排序选择样本的规划器，但不适用于 MPPI 等按代价加权的规划方法。SOAR 只在第一轮 CEM 候选上估计排名一致性，而后续精英候选的分布可能不同，因此在后续迭代进行探测或许还能进一步压缩。作者还指出，使用 top-K 重叠作为探测标准以及采用更细粒度的预算集合，是未来可能的改进方向。
papers.abstract_cn: 潜在世界模型通过变换器预测器滚动预测数百条候选动作序列，因此一次决策可能需要几十秒。现有加速方法通常像视觉语言模型一样剪枝空间标记；然而，基于采样的规划器只利用预测代价对候选序列进行排序，因此只要排序保持不变，滚动过程就可以自由压缩。我们提出 SOAR，一种无需训练、能够保持排序一致性的滚动压缩方法，可针对每次规划决策进行自适应调整。在每次决策中，SOAR 在多个标记预算下测试少量候选序列，并保留能够维持候选排序的最小预算，从而在不依赖任务标签的情况下，将压缩程度推进到当前决策所允许的最大范围。我们通过超过 80,000 个闭环回合的研究固定滚动过程的其他部分：唯一读取真实观测的第一步保持精确计算，而上下文帧则通过缓存避免重复计算。在七项导航和操作任务上，使用冻结的模型检查点，SOAR 在达到密集计算级别规划成功率的同时实现了 2.3 倍加速，并在 2.5 倍加速下保留 98% 的成功率。代码地址为 https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR。

papers.title: Draft Forcing: Target-guided Speculative Drafting and Learned Verifier for Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly. While chunk-level speculative decoding can offload chunks to a lightweight draft model, existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (1) an off-the-shelf draft diverges from the target's trajectory, compounding errors in history; and (2) they either omit verification or rely on costly post-decode aesthetic scores rather than verifying consistency against the target. We address both with Draft Forcing, a framework coupling target-guided drafting with an on-policy trained verifier. Specifically, to align the draft for high acceptance, we opt for feature-level drafting, conditioning it on multi-layer target hidden states persisted from committed chunks, whose outputs are pushed to match target trajectories with multi-aspect losses. For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target. It is trained on speculative rollouts as contexts anneal from random to inference-aligned mixtures, and gates proposals without VAE decoding. On the 14B Self-Forcing target, Draft Forcing achieves $1.63\times$ DiT and $1.57\times$ end-to-end speedups on VBench with minimal quality loss, and up to $1.93\times$ DiT ($1.82\times$ end-to-end) when combined with orthogonal KV compression. It generalizes to accelerate a streaming variant of MiniMax-H3, generating over $50\%$ draft frames with competitive quality.
papers.summary_cn: Autoregressive video diffusion models enable streaming synthesis chunk by chunk, yet invoking the large model for every chunk remains costly.
papers.contribution_cn: For verification, we propose an on-policy trained feature-space verifier predicting CDF-calibrated frame-wise relative RMSE against the target.
papers.relevance_cn: 匹配研究线：streaming video, video generation；关键词：autoregressive, streaming, self-forcing, video generation, video diffusion
papers.limitations_cn: 规则模式无法可靠判断实验质量与论文局限。

papers.title: On-Policy Codec Distillation for Efficient All-in-One Video Generation
papers.abstract: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence. Consequently, conditioning quickly dominates the computation cost. Yet most of these tokens carry redundant spatiotemporal information. Our key insight is that identifying what is genuinely new is exactly the problem that classical video codecs have long solved. Thus, we first introduce a codec-based token pruning method that discards redundant tokens. Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation. Together, they form On-Policy Codec Distillation (CodecOPSD). We scale CodecOPSD to 16 condition modalities on our own video diffusion model, where it prunes 66% of the condition tokens on average with almost no quality drop. Therefore, denoising becomes 2x faster, and the cache memory shrinks by up to 73% in KV cache mode. CodecOPSD also extends to other state-of-the-art pretrained image and video generative models, where its benefit grows further with more conditions, longer frames, and higher resolution.
papers.summary_cn: Modern visual generative models operate on tokens, and every visual asset they receive, whether an identity, a scribble, a depth map, or a motion video, is tokenized and appended to the input token sequence.
papers.contribution_cn: Then, we propose an on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) strategy to train a DiT adapter capable of learning the codec pruning pattern well without quality degradation.

papers.title: Plan Big, Paint Small: Semantic-Aware Computation Allocation for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion streams a video chunk by chunk, but large AR models are too slow for real-time use. We ask where in an AR rollout a large model is actually needed. Pairing Krea-Realtime-14B with Self-Forcing-1.3B, which share their latent space and denoising schedule, we find that the order of the two models matters: when the 14B model generates only the first chunk and the 1.3B model continues, the rollout keeps 95\% of the 14B model's semantic advantage, whereas the reverse allocation keeps 16\% at about ten times the cost. The large model decides what the video shows; the small model only has to carry it forward. We turn this into BigSmall, a training-free planner--renderer sampler. The 14B model plans the opening chunk and sketches the chunks in which content changes, which preserves motion, and the 1.3B model renders the rest; a faster variant, BigSmall, plans only the opening chunk. A cross-model KV cache that is approximate, windowed and lazy lets the planner leave and re-enter the rollout at low cost. On VBench, BigSmall is $3.02\times$ faster than the 14B model at an unchanged semantic score and motion, and $1.55\times$ faster than SDVG, which lets the small model draft first; BigSmall reaches $3.77\times$ at the same semantic score, trading away 10\% of the motion. On minute-long videos (LoCoT2V-Bench), where the 14B model degrades when it reads its own long history, BigSmall is $3.14\times$ faster than the 14B model and scores higher ($+1.78$).`

papers.title: AxE: Benchmarking Agent-Environment Generalization of Video World Models via Grounded Events
papers.abstract: Edge cases are not the long tail; they are the norm. An embodied system deployed across changing environments, bodies, objects, and tasks will routinely encounter combinations that were absent from its training data. General-purpose physical intelligence therefore requires world models that reuse prior knowledge, predict consequences, and adapt with little or no additional training. Yet current evaluations of conditional video generation emphasize visual quality, prompt alignment, or isolated physical plausibility, leaving systematic generalization difficult to measure. We introduce AxE Bench, a benchmark that organizes condition changes along eight factors of the acting agent and of its environment, and pairs every original condition with controlled variants that change one side or both. WBench-plus applies the same structure to an existing multi-turn benchmark, pairing each WBench scenario with variants on the environment side, through its world setting or camera behavior, or on the agent side, through its interaction instructions. Additionally, to score generated futures, we develop an evaluation harness that combines vision-language reasoning with targeted computer-vision evidence, converting each video into temporally localized events and comparing generated events with reference events in both time and semantics. We summarize each model with the AxE Score, event Fidelity weighted by its Stability across original-variant pairs. Across twenty models, generated events match reference events far more often in timing than in content: no model exceeds a Fidelity of 13.01, the highest Stability is 0.55, and the highest AxE Score is 7.10. Together, these components turn world-model generalization from an informal aspiration into a falsifiable evaluation program for real and simulated interactions. Our project website can be found at: AxEBench.github.io

papers.title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
papers.abstract: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories. Yet for autoregressive (AR) video generation, existing few-step models still rely on distribution matching distillation (DMD) to remain competitive, sacrificing sample diversity and requiring a large bidirectional teacher. In this work, we analyze what limits standalone AR FlowMap distillation and introduce two complementary guidance mechanisms to close this gap: (1) anti-drifting guidance, which helps the AR teacher correct drifted student rollouts by training an auxiliary model to mimic student drift and using it as a negative guidance branch; and (2) motion-aware guidance, which makes motion easier for a FlowMap student to learn by locating motion patches and selectively applying skip-layer guidance. Empirically, our approach applies to $π$-Flow, MeanFlow, and consistency distillation with 1.3B AR teachers, improving generation quality and reducing drift over 30 s rollouts. Notably, our 4-step $π$-Flow students match DMD students distilled from 14B teachers on VBench while preserving the sample diversity of their AR teachers, demonstrating that pure FlowMap distillation is effective for few-step autoregressive video generation.
papers.summary_cn: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories.

papers.title: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.

papers.title: FlexVSR: Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution for Streaming Video Generation
papers.abstract: Real-time streaming video generation has gained rapid momentum in live content creation and interactive media. Deploying such systems in practice requires flexible scaling factors to accommodate diverse source resolutions, target displays, and computational budgets. However, extending fixed-scale generative video super-resolution (VSR) to varying target scales poses two challenges: downsampling from a larger fixed scale incurs redundant cost, while re-optimizing the diffusion transformer (DiT) is costly and alters the shared generative prior. To address both, we propose FlexVSR, a decoupled framework for continuous-scale streaming generative VSR with supervision at only a few scales. Our key insight is that naively resampling fixed-scale latents onto a new target grid induces scale-dependent input mismatch, which can be effectively addressed through parameter-efficient, scale-aware adaptation of the latent interface without updating the DiT. To this end, FlexVSR introduces ReLSA (Refined Latent Scale Adaptation), a lightweight latent adapter that constructs and refines target-grid latents before they enter the DiT, enabling a shared frozen VSR prior to generalize across continuous scales with only 0.274M trainable parameters and an adaptation cost of 7.3 H100 GPU-hours, while introducing no additional temporal dependencies and preserving the native causal streaming protocol. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive or superior reconstruction and temporal quality, lower latency than most native-scale streaming baselines and offline methods, and effective generalization to unseen continuous scales, filling the continuous-scale gap in real-time streaming generative VSR.
